I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread: Orlavine Medical Supply is at 50 seats.

That figure comes from Gideon's 14 Oct post in the channel. He was correcting Moss's 30 Sep digest, which said 55. I couldn't find an Orlavine account file to check it against, so I told her it rests on Gideon's word and suggested she use 50 for the pod sheet.
